packaged: Against actual guard+click/wait implementation, a finite original observation that returns after the same original phase deadline must refuse with original error and perform zero subsequent DOM evaluation or physical mouse pair.

In-budget immediately ready stable target reaches exactly one mouse pair with all seven fresh owner checks and original geometry/ownership predicates intact; invalid owner, PID birth, currentness or changed final geometry remains a hard negative.

For the existing failure publisher, malformed/accessor/oversized/serialization/writer-failure projections must retain original result/error/action/cleanup and UTF-8 cap. Such tests prove evidence integrity, not a 10 s platform pass.

Any future performance proposal needs measured actual component cost and an exact-source original Windows journey under unchanged clock; finite helper tests alone cannot establish scheduling/performance on Windows.
process: Use actual driver/Host readiness path with finite original catalog/config/MCP/probe seams to distinguish pending, false, rejected and successful later stages; attach/open and earlier catalog success must never make nativeReady true before the final original await completes.
Original 15 s poll must still refuse a true result returning late, with no extra allocation/open/provider action or reset/replay.

Reference/currentness tests should distinguish in-budget reference success from exact expiry/scope/account/origin revocation refusal, preserving separate fresh checks and original reference identity; a 277 ms bracket is not itself a repair target.
Actual diagnosis still requires original-stage correlated evidence for the unresolved invocation; synthetic source regressions cannot retroactively establish which historical await stalled.
